verdict.rationale: Loops says agents can create draft campaigns, content included, through the API, and a human then reviews and sends them from the dashboard. That matches the draft-then-human-approval flow in the story. The Content API/LMX lets agents author campaign content in code, MCP and the CLI give agents access, Guardian checks can run on a message before send, and segments exist on the platform. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a draft can be targeted at a segment via the API, any scheduled-send or approval-queue mechanism beyond 'review in dashboard', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
